overflow_fill: wrap long lines of text to a specified maximum width using Python textwrap for cleaner display
review_vizualize_translated_files: review the vizualize_translated_files function to understand how it handles beam search output visualization with optional IR processing
refactor_vizualize_translated_files: refactor vizualize_translated_files to support additional output columns or different tokenization modes beyond fastbpe
